The area of $ABCD$ is $61{\text{ mm}}^{2}.$ What is the area of $△BCD$ rounded to the nearest integer?" :question/worked-solution "Let's start by finding the area of $△ABD.$ We get 

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}_{△ABD} & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot AB\cdot AD\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡A \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 16\cdot 10\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{90}^{∘} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 160\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{90}^{∘} \\ & ≈80{\text{ mm}}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the nearest integer.

The difference of the areas of $△ABD$ and the quadrilateral $ABCD$ gives the area of $△BCD.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}_{△BCD} & ={A}_{△ABD}-{A}_{ABCD} \\ & =80-61 \\ & =19{\text{ mm}}^{2}.\end{aligned}

$$
